##### ibex Expands Global Service Delivery Network with New State-of-the-Art Center in Egypt


Hiring is Underway for Agents, Managers, Team Leaders, and Support Staff; Expected to Scale to 1,000 Employees Within First Nine Months


### Hiring is Underway for Agents, Managers, Team Leaders, and Support Staff; Expected to Scale to 1,000 Employees Within First Nine Months


WASHINGTON and CAIRO, Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[ibex](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=WHXuNbEQc38cuIOl5WONFAwlLf2CBEO6yJ34MVY_CbYFYOcKwfEWBFyb1mKuqyN9c_jQjrtnR0hiQGxbHquEMg==) (Nasdaq: IBEX), the global leader in outsourced business services and AI-powered customer experience solutions, today announced its official entry into Egypt with a new state-of-the-art service delivery center in Cairo to support clients across key growth industries, including HealthTech, Technology, and Retail. This expansion strengthens ibex's global delivery network and underscores its commitment to providing scalable, world-class CX outsourcing services for top global brands.


“We are excited to expand into Egypt to deliver even greater service options and value for our growing list of industry-leading companies,” said ibex CEO Bob Dechant. “Egypt is a thriving outsourcing and technology market with a unique combination of a young, multilingual, and highly educated workforce, coupled with a strategic geographic location, growing digital infrastructure, and a stable, pro-business government environment. In addition to creating new employment opportunities and bringing foreign investment to Cairo, this expansion enhances our ability to deliver truly differentiated customer experiences for global brands.”


ibex’s new Cairo service delivery center, located in the City Stars complex at Ali Rashed St., Nasr City, Cairo, will feature multiple training rooms and modern support areas, including a cafeteria, prayer room, data rooms, and administrative suite. The new facility will begin operations in October, with plans to scale to 1,000 in the first nine months, along with significant capital investment. Hiring is already underway for customer service representatives, front-line managers, team leaders, quality analysts, and support staff.


ibex has been recognized for its outstanding culture, employee experience, development opportunities, and service, including Great Place to Work, Forbes’ Best Employers for Women, and Newsweek’s Greatest Workplaces for Professional Services.


“We believe that providing a great employee experience is the key to delivering amazing customer experiences, and we are dedicated to continually improving our award-winning culture that offers our team members the best training, tools, and development opportunities,” said Paul Inson, Chief People Officer at ibex.


To join the winning ibex team, job seekers are encouraged to apply online at[https://careers.ibex.co/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=MO3upLFTe5vbk0aI9ZSU__jgcfqFTtcRG3tNwhf01yJPbMsB7xf5GWomNqoL3JY5dFo1du8MTXJnghZDMQL5ESjasrBcxdorqosVzYEx1FA=) . Follow @ibexegypt on Instagram and Facebook.


ibex Cairo will operate under ibex’s comprehensive portfolio of security and compliance certifications and standards, including ISO 42001 and 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and PCI DSS. ibex also holds the top spot for BPO providers in[SecurityScorecard’s](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=YmkdXTbS_mw3BvFrPK6jaceZc9PbK7OV6EFu8f49piS6KvCXJCZacR9L45YcD6J52CFcCE252mgH-6AT0qvrAHBOgiWIYVZ33HwU5VYf8xE=) cybersecurity ranking with a rating of 100, demonstrating its strong security posture and commitment to protecting client data globally.


**About ibex**
ibex is a global leader in outsourced business services and AI-powered customer experience solutions, enabling the world’s best brands to deliver truly differentiated experiences for their customers. Leveraging a global team of more than 36,000 human CX experts – powered by the best AI technology, decades of CX innovation, and deep business insights – ibex engineers seamless, end-to-end customer journeys from AI agents to human agents at scale across retail, e-commerce, healthcare, fintech, utilities, technology, logistics, and more. Discover more at[ibex.co](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=JY8NKzxwqsmIJVsHXAr5YDRhP98obM8lVe6oVDmkFVm1ASZHpeq6QQYhuY34zUiHlMVEklsiwDTDP0ZyYLjI8w==) and connect with us on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tYMDc_Cs0ZF3KhtZVa8osi3Tg23e2QM7rV99t8ZsU7nRpYlKGtQkN_xwAsAPCYqtk3Z9H-5j_sCs8z2eWNqRdBPWKzm_4b6Cxiwmgbdx-A1AsY49-us4KqygmsgW9rAB94MoenDjg0zUgmIJFpDstA==) .
